children: Patrick Witt, executive director of the U.S. President's Digital Assets Advisory Council, appeared to signal support for the CLARITY Act ahead of an upcoming Senate vote, saying skeptics of the bill were having a bad day. According to Odaily, Polymarket shows the probability of the bill passing in 2026 at 20%.

title: Patrick Witt Signals Support for CLARITY Act Ahead of Senate Vote
